title: MUSIC ACTIVITIES GRADE 1
text:
HOLIDAY ASSIGNMENT
 GRADE 1 MUSIC
COMPLETE GRADE ONE HOME ASSIGNMENT
 MUSIC ACTIVITIES GRADE 1
 1. ‘Ee Mungu yetu. (nguvu, nyota)
 2. Draw and colour a shaker.
 3. Draw and colour a kayamba.
 4. Draw and colour a drum.
 5. Draw and colour a flag.
 6. A is a song sang to small babies. (chorus, lullaby)
 7. ___________________ is the top colour on the flag. (white, black)
 8. ‘Jesus I love you’ is sang in the . (Church, party)
 9. Songs that are sang in the Church are songs.
 (Sacred, Patriotic)
 10.“Lala mtoto lala” is a song. (lullaby, wedding)
